BASELINE (Non-AI numeric fitting):
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Verilog-AMS Behavioral Model
// Generated by circuit_preprocess pipeline
// Date: 2026-03-29 12:00:26
//
// Module: tx_out_n_vs_tx_in_p
// Model type: dynamic
// Intent: amplifier
// DC gain: 2.222e-01
// Bandwidth: 7.004e+04 Hz
// Time constant: 2.271e-06 s

`include "disciplines.vams"

module tx_out_n_vs_tx_in_p (
  input electrical tx_in_p,
  output electrical tx_out_n
);

  // Dynamic model parameters
  parameter real dc_gain = 0.2222222222222223;
  parameter real bandwidth = 70037.90451392293;  // Hz
  parameter real time_constant = 2.2714972727272727e-06;  // seconds
  parameter real output_resistance = 1.0;  // Output resistance (Ohms) for numerical stability

  // Model class: first_order_lag
  // Transfer function: H(s) = 2.222e-01 / (1 + s*2.271e-06)

  real v_ideal;

  analog begin
    // Simple DC gain model with Thevenin equivalent
    v_ideal = dc_gain * V(tx_in_p);
    I(tx_out_n) <+ (v_ideal - V(tx_out_n)) / output_resistance;
  end

endmodule

  parameter real output_resistance = 1.0;  // Output resistance (Ohms) for numerical stability

  // Model class: dc_only (DC-only, no dynamics available)

  real v_ideal;

  analog begin
    // Simple DC gain model with Thevenin equivalent
    v_ideal = dc_gain * V(tx_in_n);
    I(tx_out_p) <+ (v_ideal - V(tx_out_p)) / output_resistance;
  end

endmodule
